notes.title: 0.7 Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi all! Kind of a small update, in preparation of a much bigger one later. We're putting to test 2 new mechanics that will be the building blocks of a future "meta-game" based on the Village, buildings, characters and quests.[/p][p]Those mechanics are:[/p][list][*][p]Every item has now up to 3 materials that can be salvaged by trashing the item (or when the game is over). For now it has no use except to show off in the mountain map, but later those resources will be used in the Village to unlock new buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]4 quests are implemented, one is chosen randomly for now, but later those quests will be given by characters to unlock new features.[/p][/*][/list][p]Also we've started to work on a cleaner UI in preparation for the upcoming Demo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/33b1d9393fae8f1edb296d059a91c4e014e43c82.png"][/img][/p][p]It's kind of a "dev/preview" build but any feedback is welcome, here or on our Discord server! Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.6
notes.notes: [p]Update 0.6 is in![/p][p][/p][h3]Object Art[/h3][p]We implemented all the missing art for the objects we wanted for the upcoming demo! We hope you'll enjoy this nice addition.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/1b7fab6b31e5d5ac0a5a75271bfd173f54e2f693.png"][/img]From now on and until we release our first official demo in october, we'll host object creation contest on our social networks and our [url="https://discord.gg/kAQXzQJMGm"]Discord[/url]! Join in to give us your ideas! The first winner is a delicious Chocolat Bar:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/29c4b7d18f1e820f194a4a6cfc1df638b191e7f3.png"][/img][/p][h3]Events[/h3][p]In some regions you'll notice new information about effects that take place when you're there. Beware![/p][h3]Health Update[/h3][p]We reworked how Life Points are lost to avoid abrupt game over. Let us know what you think![/p][h3]Anomalies[/h3][p]Some items (such as the chocolate) come from another timeline and are obtained by interacting by Anomalies in the world. Can you find all of these technologically advanced objects?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/332d17e12cac473448c4a9337e5869d6901e2658.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Playtest version 0.5.3
notes.notes: [p]Hi all and thanks for all of you who take time to provide unvaluable feedback! For those who don't, know that any feedback is welcome and you can comment on Steam or on our [url="https://discord.gg/kAQXzQJMGm"]Discord server[/url], or directly on our mail adress contact\[at]mudita.games.[/p][p][/p][h1]0.5.3[/h1][p]0.5.3 features a lot of changes. We focused on UX improvements to make everything more fluid and nice, but we're also putting a couple of new features on test.[/p][p][/p][h1]Bag Upgrades[/h1][p]At the end of every biomes you will now find a (placeholder) screen where you can choose from 4 bag upgrades! [/p][list][*][p]You can make your bag bigger by adding new pockets[/p][/*][*][p]You can get "Straps" that allow you to carry [b]any[/b] item you want[/p][/*][*][p]You can even stick [b]Badges[/b] to your bag to get unique bonuses![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/8bbfe848b4587d82bf6870e3d2735a62efad9f8d.png"][/img][/p][p]"Strength" mechanic has been discontinued.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]New biomes prototypes[/h2][p]2 new regions can now be explored. Art is not done so we're using placeholder art and some color swap to show the change. The aim is to test how having a variety of biomes can impact gameplay and overall pacing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/3ff2182c7fd140f3d346a76dd99486b53cdbca53.png"][/img][/p][p]A "cold" biome where low temperature can freeze items right in your bag. The biome is also heavier on fatigue but lighter on challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/2f4c7d65abcac3970aeec435ca675efcdfd2663e.png"][/img][/p][p]Home of the mysterious Ants, the jungle features more fights. But Rust will also damage your metallic items![/p][p][/p][h2]New effects[/h2][p]We updated art and FX and older effects but we're also testing a couple of new ones.[/p][h3]Cold[/h3][p]As shown above, low temperatures can feeze your items in your bag and make them unmovable. To balance the effect, "Fear" will now only make your items unusable. You'll be able to move them.[/p][h3]Illness[/h3][p]Already in previous version, illness make your items weaker, but moreover will spread every time your travel![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/9fc3171c327210f10bce594c26033848938dab03.png"][/img][/p][h3]Madness[/h3][p]A very fun effect that can someone turn in your favor, Madness will shuffle your object effects. Maybe it will make it better?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/620321ea56d4580b06598a80b6b8aa08f3d20b04.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Prediction & Remove Ailment[/h3][p]Two new mechanics have been introduced. "Prediction" was an old mechanic that's now used to reveal info on the Mountain Map. The higher you go the more you'll need it![/p][p]To compensate the addition of new negative effect, a new positive effect has been added: Remove Ailment will cure any issue on an item.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Many bugs have been fixed, and tons of new UX effects have been added to make the whole experience more fluid and nice. We hope you'll like it![/p][p][/p][h1]Playtest is now open to everyone![/h1][p]From 0.5.3 and until the official Demo is added in september, playtest is now open to everyone! Let your friends know![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 0.4 Content Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/231a23da24945c5450be944981b2d025be16be82.png"][/img][/p][p]Happy to introduce a new game-changing feature: the Mountain Map![/p][p]It will allow your travel to be more tactical and awesome.[/p][p][b]Let us know what you think![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Also, a bunch of fixes and QoL, including:[/p][list][*][p]New "shake bag" feature[/p][/*][*][p]Game altitude is now display on game over screen[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.3 Update
notes.notes:
- 3 new zone prototypes! Merchant (will trade items for their value), Fire Camp (throw items in the fire to get bonuses), and Boss (a big enemy with several life points). Tell us what you think!
- We reworked how the mountain and the environmnent are made, so the overall visual quality has improved
- Many bug have been fixed
- Global difficulty balance
